overviewParagraph.overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Dynamic Lucca Elite 2-Person Ultra Low EMF FAR Infrared Sauna offers a premium wellness retreat right in your home. Designed for relaxation and rejuvenation, this sauna features 7 strategically placed Ultra Low EMF FAR infrared carbon heating panels, providing soothing heat that promotes muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. Constructed from elegant Honey Dark Stain Canadian Hemlock wood, it includes modern amenities like Bluetooth connectivity and an interior Chromotherapy Color Lighting System. Ideal for indoor spaces such as basements or fitness rooms, this sauna ensures a luxurious, spa-like experience with easy assembly and a dedicated outlet requirement.
